invariants.statement: Every active or archived bookmark record has a unique asset tag
invariants.applicability: From record creation until permanent deletion

scope.description: All bookmark records including archived records

postconditions: No other bookmark record has the accepted asset tag
invariants.detection: Check the unique key before or during commit
invariants.recovery: Reject the change with an asset-tag validation error

owner.authority: May reject a write that duplicates an asset tag
owner.rationale: The bookmark transaction owns the unique-key check and commit
